result.summary: The page is mostly visually coherent, but a few elements look incomplete or awkwardly clipped, especially the top-right circular control and horizontally scrolling content at the screen edge.

issues.description: The top-right circular button appears blank except for a small red dot, making it look like an icon or avatar failed to load.
issues.suggestion: Add the intended icon/avatar inside the circle, or remove the button if it is not actionable. If the red dot is a notification indicator, anchor it to a visible icon.

issues.description: The horizontal category chips are cut off on the right edge, with only a sliver of the next chip visible. This can look visually broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add more right padding, show a clearer partial chip, or provide a fade/scroll affordance to indicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' row is partially clipped at the right edge, including its title text. While likely a carousel, it appears abrupt in the screenshot.
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel spacing and clipping are intentional, or add a subtle edge fade/peek layout so users understand more items are horizontally scrollable.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlays the lower portion of the restaurant list, cutting off the next card image near the bottom of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards are not visually hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation.
